title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E06 — Nepalese Kukri
The bladesmiths are tasked with the challenge of shaping four very different types of metal into a fully functional deadly weapon; two will have just five days to make one of the most lethal weapons in military history, the Nepalese Kukri.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E07 — The Shotel
Four bladesmiths are challenged with taking high carbon steel and wrought iron and forging a fully functional weapon; two will move on to the final round where they'll have just five days to make the Ethiopian Shotel.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E04 — Spiked Shield
The blade smiths are asked to forge three or more metals into a blade of their signature style; two move on to the final round returning home to make a legendary spiked shield; only one emerges to be crowned the Forged in Fire Champion.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E03 — The Scottish Claymore
Four blade smiths face grueling challenges when the electricity and power tools are taken away from them; only two will survive and move on to the final round where they'll have just five days to create the iconic Scottish Claymore.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E37 — Judges Takeover: Dave Baker
In a special Judge's Takeover competition, four smiths must re-create the Bone Daddy Fantasy Seax, a favorite of Hollywood weapon maker Dave Baker; after a round of tests, two remaining smiths return to their home forges to make a Fantasy Broadsword.

title: Forged in Fire: Beat the Judges
description:
S01 E05 — The No Can Can
Three Forged in Fire Champions return for an opportunity to take down a judge; however, after a grueling round of testing, only two move forward to recreate a Falcata.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E02 — Khopesh
The bladesmiths are given a twisted challenge when they are asked to create a weapon from cable steel; after two rounds only two are left to return home and forge an Egyptian Khopesh.

description:

The final six marksmen must shoot from unstable platforms; Iain Harrison returns to lend a steady hand; tension among the final competitors comes to a head.

description:

Marksmen shoot while hanging from a 125-foot crane; the final five marksmen face the two biggest challenges of the competition.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E21 — Darth Pawn
The Pawn Stars check out a 1763 Stradivarius violin; Rick and Chumlee meet a man selling life-sized Star Wars figures; Rick and the Old Man check out the World War II airplane's version of GPS, an octant.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E01 — Peeping Pawn
The team is presented with a rare 1776 Massachusetts penny made by Paul Revere; Rick has an opportunity to buy a hand grenade made by an American World War II spy program; Rick and Corey meet a man hoping to sell his 1950s peep show machine.

title: American Pickers
description:
S09 E08 — Traders of the Lost Parts
The guys scour an extraordinary New Jersey collection; Mike finds a rare 1911 Harley motor he needs to complete a project; Dave's heavenly stockpile.

title: American Pickers
description:
S19 E20 — One Wheel Deal
In Missouri, the guys visit an historic homestead where they join the search for grandpa's lost Civil War uniform.

title: American Restoration
description:
S03 E27 — Big Boom
A 1900s signal cannon is brought into the shop; the shop attempts to hold their first auction; 1950s Italian folding bicycle.

title: American Restoration
description:
S03 E11 — Pump & Gun
Rick and his crew take a shot in the dark when a 1943 trap machine lands in the shop; Ron and Tyler find a rare rusty pump while on the road.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E26 — Wise Guys
The Pawn Stars are presented with a fully functional 1941 M3 Armored Scout Truck from World War II; Rick and Corey meet a man hoping to sell a check signed by notorious mobster Carlo Gambino; Rick and Chumlee check out a 1987 Apple II GS Computer.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E02 — Ace in the Hole
The team is presented with an antique professional gambler's toolkit; Rick and Corey look to buy rare pieces of 1896 U.S. currency; a man hopes to sell his 1950s radiation detecting Geiger counter.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E04 — Getting a Head
The guys are presented with a 1969 Buick Skylark; Chumlee and the Old Man look to buy a Civil War field desk complete with captured Confederate documents; Rick is presented with a human shrunken head.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E06 — Ready, Set, Pawn
A seller brings in a competition dragster racecar; Rick and Corey are presented with a Japanese land mine training kit used during World War II; Corey and Chumlee check out a fully restored 1957 Dr. Pepper vending machine.

description:
